messages:
marie.docs: FYI I'm about to land a docs migration that consolidates provisioning examples and adds a matrix of tenant scenarios for Dedicated. Would love quick sanity checks on the autoscale snippets and isolation wording. TL;DR: small PR, big surface area for edge cases.
kevin.eng: happy to review. where are you planning to add the tenant scenarios? a single table or per-section examples?
marie.docs: per-section. short matrix at top and then 3 concrete examples in 'tenant-examples.md' - best-effort to keep pages <1 screen each. will link the autoscale snippet.
samir.reliability: reminder: any change that mentions preemption needs the preemption matrix link and the SLO swimlane. Otherwise oncall will get confused during failovers.
olivia.devex: can you paste the autoscale YAML you'll include? quick sanity read will catch obvious mistakes.
marie.docs: sure — snippet below. it's trimmed so let me know if label names/paths look wrong.
marie.docs: ```yaml
autoscalePolicy:
  name: burst-aware
  minPods: 2
  maxPods: 20
  cooldownSecs: 120
  tenantAffinity:
    labels:
      - name: 'tenant_class'
        values: ['gold','standard','trial']
      - name: 'isolation_required'
        values: ['true','false']
  preemptibleAllowed: true
``` 
kevin.eng: label names look fine. question: do we call the field tenantAffinity or tenant_selector elsewhere? we have older examples using tenant_selector.
marie.docs: good call — I added a compatibility note linking to the migration guide. text: 'tenantAffinity (new) maps from legacy tenant_selector — see migration section'. will add a code transform example.
samir.reliability: for SLA wording please include explicit behavior when minPods can't be met (eg: queueing + soft-degrade) and link to the fallback model variants doc.
marie.docs: added a short bullet list in the SLA section: - if minPods unavailable -> route to fallback-region; - if preemption triggers -> degrade throughput within SLO thresholds; - ops will receive paging if degraded > 5m.
olivia.devex: small nit: use backticks for field names in docs (tenantAffinity) and reference SDK snippet for the Python helper that transforms legacy config.
marie.docs: added SDK snippet link and a tiny python helper in the migration examples. paste for quick glance:
marie.docs: ```python
def migrate_selector(old):
    # transforms legacy tenant_selector to tenantAffinity
    return {'tenantAffinity': {'labels': old.get('labels', [])}}
```
kevin.eng: looks good. can you also include an example CLI command to validate the YAML before upload? saves reviewers time.
marie.docs: good idea. adding: `redwoodctl validate --file tenant-examples.yaml` in the PR.
deploy-bot: deploy-check: docs link-checker ran — 3 broken internal links in 'tenant-examples.md' (relative paths).
marie.docs: thanks bot — fixing links now.
olivia.devex: will do a pass after you push fixes. I can run the SDK snippet integration test locally.
samir.reliability: quick suggestion: add a tiny scenario called 'bulk onboarding' where scale delta is big — helps clarify cooldown+burst policy interplay.
marie.docs: added 'bulk onboarding' example and a short graph description. will ping reviewers when PR is up.
kevin.eng: ping me when it's up; I'll skim the YAML and the migration script. :thumbsup: \
olivia.devex: me too — will run SDK test. :eyes: \
marie.docs: thanks all, pushing in 20m.
